title: Tadalafil
description: How tadalafil relaxes blood vessels, its established uses and the mixed findings in Raynaud studies.
scope: Tadalafil in erectile dysfunction, benign prostatic hyperplasia, pulmonary arterial hypertension and secondary Raynaud phenomenon.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Tadalafil inhibits PDE5, an enzyme involved in smooth-muscle relaxation. It is used for erectile dysfunction, urinary symptoms from benign prostatic hyperplasia and, under a separate indication, pulmonary arterial hypertension.

sentences.text: Tadalafil inhibits PDE5, an enzyme involved in smooth-muscle relaxation. It is used for erectile dysfunction, urinary symptoms from benign prostatic hyperplasia and, under a separate indication, pulmonary arterial hypertension.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: Pulmonary arterial hypertension is an established tadalafil indication. Research in secondary Raynaud phenomenon is mixed: one small add-on trial reported improved attacks and ulcer healing, while another found no symptom advantage over placebo.

sentences.text: Pulmonary arterial hypertension is an established tadalafil indication. Research in secondary Raynaud phenomenon is mixed: one small add-on trial reported improved attacks and ulcer healing, while another found no symptom advantage over placebo.

questions.question: Does tadalafil improve Raynaud symptoms?
questions.answer: The 2010 study found fewer and shorter attacks with tadalafil added to existing vasodilators. The 2009 trial found no difference in attacks or condition score. The populations and treatment schedules differed.

sentences.text: The 2010 study found fewer and shorter attacks with tadalafil added to existing vasodilators. The 2009 trial found no difference in attacks or condition score. The populations and treatment schedules differed.

questions.question: What happened to digital ulcers?
questions.answer: In the 2010 trial, 24 of 24 existing digital lesions healed during tadalafil treatment versus 3 of 13 during placebo. These are lesion counts, not numbers of patients.

sentences.text: In the 2010 trial, 24 of 24 existing digital lesions healed during tadalafil treatment versus 3 of 13 during placebo. These are lesion counts, not numbers of patients.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Headache, indigestion, back pain, muscle pain and flushing are common adverse effects. Rare serious concerns include prolonged erection and sudden vision or hearing loss. Its vasodilator action can cause symptomatic low blood pressure; pulmonary veno-occlusive disease can worsen with pulmonary vasodilators.

sentences.text: Headache, indigestion, back pain, muscle pain and flushing are common adverse effects. Rare serious concerns include prolonged erection and sudden vision or hearing loss.
Its vasodilator action can cause symptomatic low blood pressure; pulmonary veno-occlusive disease can worsen with pulmonary vasodilators.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Organic nitrates, riociguat and a previous serious hypersensitivity reaction are contraindications.

sentences.text: Organic nitrates, riociguat and a previous serious hypersensitivity reaction are contraindications.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Alpha-blockers, antihypertensives and substantial alcohol intake can add to blood-pressure lowering. Strong CYP3A inhibitors increase tadalafil exposure; inducers can reduce it.

sentences.text: Alpha-blockers, antihypertensives and substantial alcohol intake can add to blood-pressure lowering. Strong CYP3A inhibitors increase tadalafil exposure; inducers can reduce it.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The Raynaud trials tested 20 mg daily for four weeks or 20 mg on alternate days for six weeks; neither establishes a universal Raynaud regimen. The labeled adult pulmonary-hypertension regimen is 40 mg once daily, with kidney, liver and interaction restrictions.

sentences.text: The Raynaud trials tested 20 mg daily for four weeks or 20 mg on alternate days for six weeks; neither establishes a universal Raynaud regimen.
The labeled adult pulmonary-hypertension regimen is 40 mg once daily, with kidney, liver and interaction restrictions.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: The negative Raynaud crossover trial had 39 evaluable participants. In the positive trial, 24 of 25 recruited participants completed follow-up; new digital ulcers numbered one during tadalafil and 13 during placebo.

sentences.text: The negative Raynaud crossover trial had 39 evaluable participants. In the positive trial, 24 of 25 recruited participants completed follow-up; new digital ulcers numbered one during tadalafil and 13 during placebo.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: Cialis and Adcirca contain tadalafil but have different labeled indications and regimens. Product strength and indication therefore matter when interpreting a study schedule.

sentences.text: Cialis and Adcirca contain tadalafil but have different labeled indications and regimens. Product strength and indication therefore matter when interpreting a study schedule.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: US labeling covers erectile dysfunction and benign prostatic hyperplasia for Cialis, and WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension for Adcirca. Raynaud phenomenon is outside these labeled indications.

sentences.text: US labeling covers erectile dysfunction and benign prostatic hyperplasia for Cialis, and WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension for Adcirca. Raynaud phenomenon is outside these labeled indications.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: Both Raynaud trials used crossover designs and small samples. Their conflicting results leave uncertainty about which patients benefit from tadalafil and under which background treatment.

sentences.text: Both Raynaud trials used crossover designs and small samples. Their conflicting results leave uncertainty about which patients benefit from tadalafil and under which background treatment.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: Sildenafil is another PDE5 inhibitor. Its studies provide a related comparison, while tadalafil has its own clinical trial results.

sentences.text: Sildenafil is another PDE5 inhibitor. Its studies provide a related comparison, while tadalafil has its own clinical trial results.

faqs.question: Is every type of pulmonary hypertension a tadalafil indication?
faqs.answer: No. The Adcirca indication specifies pulmonary arterial hypertension in WHO group 1.

sentences.text: No. The Adcirca indication specifies pulmonary arterial hypertension in WHO group 1.

faqs.question: Why are nitrates a major interaction?
faqs.answer: Combining nitrates with tadalafil can produce a dangerous fall in blood pressure. The label specifies at least 48 hours after the last tadalafil dose before nitrate consideration in a life-threatening emergency, with close medical monitoring.

sentences.text: Combining nitrates with tadalafil can produce a dangerous fall in blood pressure. The label specifies at least 48 hours after the last tadalafil dose before nitrate consideration in a life-threatening emergency, with close medical monitoring.

title: Aging & longevity
description: What drug studies tell us about lifespan, physical function and other outcomes of aging.
scope: Human health and function in later life, alongside the animal experiments motivating longevity research.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Healthy aging includes maintaining physical, mental and cognitive function, independence and quality of life. Longevity research also asks whether interventions can extend lifespan; these are related but distinct goals.

sentences.text: Healthy aging includes maintaining physical, mental and cognitive function, independence and quality of life. Longevity research also asks whether interventions can extend lifespan; these are related but distinct goals.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: Rapamycin has extended mouse lifespan, while human studies have examined body composition and other shorter-term outcomes. Metformin has also been tested for physical function, with no walking-speed benefit in the MET-PREVENT trial.

sentences.text: Rapamycin has extended mouse lifespan, while human studies have examined body composition and other shorter-term outcomes. Metformin has also been tested for physical function, with no walking-speed benefit in the MET-PREVENT trial.

questions.question: Have these trials shown that people live longer?
questions.answer: Neither PEARL nor MET-PREVENT tested lifespan extension as its primary outcome. They studied body composition and walking speed over months.

sentences.text: Neither PEARL nor MET-PREVENT tested lifespan extension as its primary outcome. They studied body composition and walking speed over months.

questions.question: Does metformin improve muscle function with age?
questions.answer: MET-PREVENT found no improvement in walking speed in older adults with probable sarcopenia and frailty or prefrailty. In MASTERS, metformin reduced gains in lean mass during resistance training compared with placebo.

sentences.text: MET-PREVENT found no improvement in walking speed in older adults with probable sarcopenia and frailty or prefrailty. In MASTERS, metformin reduced gains in lean mass during resistance training compared with placebo.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: PEARL analyzed 114 completers after 48 weeks and found no significant difference in visceral adiposity, its primary outcome. Some secondary measures, including lean mass and pain in women, improved; small subgroups, multiple comparisons and exclusion of 11 dropouts limit the result. The mouse lifespan experiments are direct survival tests in mice. Translating that result to human lifespan requires a different kind and duration of study.

sentences.text: PEARL analyzed 114 completers after 48 weeks and found no significant difference in visceral adiposity, its primary outcome. Some secondary measures, including lean mass and pain in women, improved; small subgroups, multiple comparisons and exclusion of 11 dropouts limit the result.
The mouse lifespan experiments are direct survival tests in mice. Translating that result to human lifespan requires a different kind and duration of study.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Sirolimus can increase infection risk, impair wound healing and raise blood lipids. Strong CYP3A/P-glycoprotein interactions, including grapefruit, can alter exposure. Metformin can cause gastrointestinal effects and vitamin B12 depletion; severe kidney impairment increases lactic-acidosis risk.

sentences.text: Sirolimus can increase infection risk, impair wound healing and raise blood lipids. Strong CYP3A/P-glycoprotein interactions, including grapefruit, can alter exposure.
Metformin can cause gastrointestinal effects and vitamin B12 depletion; severe kidney impairment increases lactic-acidosis risk.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: PEARL studied generally healthy adults aged 50–85, whereas MET-PREVENT recruited much older adults with impaired physical function. The different populations and outcomes do not support ranking these drugs for a single “anti-aging” benefit.

sentences.text: PEARL studied generally healthy adults aged 50–85, whereas MET-PREVENT recruited much older adults with impaired physical function. The different populations and outcomes do not support ranking these drugs for a single “anti-aging” benefit.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The sirolimus, metformin and sarcopenia profiles explain the individual drugs and physical-function outcomes in greater detail.

sentences.text: The sirolimus, metformin and sarcopenia profiles explain the individual drugs and physical-function outcomes in greater detail.

faqs.question: Does the rapamycin formulation matter?
faqs.answer: PEARL used compounded rapamycin; the authors found substantially lower blood concentrations than with commercial formulations. Its nominal weekly doses therefore cannot be assumed equivalent to commercial tablets.

sentences.text: PEARL used compounded rapamycin; the authors found substantially lower blood concentrations than with commercial formulations. Its nominal weekly doses therefore cannot be assumed equivalent to commercial tablets.

faqs.question: What does walking speed add to this question?
faqs.answer: Walking speed measures physical performance. It can inform a question about mobility, but the four-month MET-PREVENT comparison did not measure how long participants lived.

sentences.text: Walking speed measures physical performance. It can inform a question about mobility, but the four-month MET-PREVENT comparison did not measure how long participants lived.
